# Garg Agency Pharma

> > Pharmaceutical distribution agency offering prescription medicines from leading Indian manufacturers including Ajanta Pharma, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, Glenmark, Laborate, and Dr. Reddy's.

Garg Agency Pharma serves as a pharmaceutical distributor providing detailed product information, pricing, and availability for antibiotics, antifungals, pain relief medications, respiratory treatments, and specialty formulations across therapeutic categories.
